name: "Build 🔨"

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - '**'
      - '!Translations/*.lproj/**'
      - 'Translations/en.lproj/**'
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened
      - reopened
      - synchronize
      - ready_for_review
    branches: [ main ]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    name: "Build 🔨"
    if: github.event.pull_request.draft == false
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        scheme:
          - "Swiftfin"
          - "Swiftfin tvOS"

    runs-on: xcode-27

    env:
      XCODE_VERSION: "27.1"
      FASTLANE_XCODEBUILD_SETTINGS_TIMEOUT: "120"
      FASTLANE_XCODEBUILD_SETTINGS_RETRIES: "2"

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.3'
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Install Homebrew dependencies
        run: brew bundle --file Brewfile

      - name: Restore Swift packages
        id: swift-packages
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v6
        with:
          path: |
            build/SourcePackages/checkouts
            build/SourcePackages/repositories
            build/SourcePackages/artifacts
            build/SourcePackages/workspace-state.json
          key: spm-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ env.XCODE_VERSION }}-${{ matrix.scheme }}-${{ hashFiles('Swiftfin.xcodeproj/project.xcworkspace/xcshareddata/swiftpm/Package.resolved') }}
          restore-keys: |
            spm-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ env.XCODE_VERSION }}-${{ matrix.scheme }}-

      - name: Build
        uses: nick-fields/retry@v4
        env:
          SCHEME: ${{ matrix.scheme }}
        with:
          max_attempts: 3
          retry_on: error
          timeout_minutes: 60
          command: |
            bundle exec fastlane buildLane \
              "scheme:$SCHEME" \
              "xcodeVersion:$XCODE_VERSION"

      - name: Save Swift packages
        if: ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'schedule') && steps.swift-packages.outputs.cache-hit != 'true' }}
        uses: actions/cache/save@v6
        with:
          path: |
            build/SourcePackages/checkouts
            build/SourcePackages/repositories
            build/SourcePackages/artifacts
            build/SourcePackages/workspace-state.json
          key: ${{ steps.swift-packages.outputs.cache-primary-key }}

      - name: Package unsigned IPA
        env:
          SCHEME: ${{ matrix.scheme }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p fastlane/build/Payload
          cp -R fastlane/build/*.xcarchive/Products/Applications/*.app fastlane/build/Payload/
          cd fastlane/build
          zip -r -y "$SCHEME-unsigned.ipa" Payload

      - name: Upload unsigned IPA
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.scheme }}-unsigned
          path: fastlane/build/*-unsigned.ipa
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
